entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: A black-green-blue clan of Tarkir that admires the dragons' ruthlessness, originally ruled by humans and later by nagas and rakshasa, then enslaved by Silumgar, and now revived as an agrarian nation.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the five clans and dragon broods.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The dragonlord who enslaved the Sultai; defeated by the rebellion after being weakened by the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: A human Sultai khan who betrayed the other khans to the dragons and became Silumgar's slave and trophy.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: A naga who considered herself queen of the Sultai in the original timeline, reduced to one of Silumgar's undead underlings in the new one.

entities.name: Kotis
entities.description: A formerly human sibsig and the Fangkeeper of the Sultai.

entities.name: Teval
entities.description: A Spirit Dragon who aided the rebels against Silumgar and now acts as an impartial judge with the Fangkeeper.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose saving of Ugin created the current timeline.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker saved by Sarkhan Vol.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: The Jeskai khan who regarded the Sultai as protectors of the other clans from jungle horrors.

entities.name: Ikra Shidiqi
entities.description: A naga advisor to Tasigur who became Silumgar's dragonspeaker.

entities.name: Feyomsi
entities.description: A rakshasa sorcerer and necromancer who personally taught Sidisi and governed the necropolis of Ukud.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A human who was the personal enforcer of the Sultai Khan in the original timeline.

entities.name: Dauna
entities.description: Chief necromancer of the new Sultai.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Demons who took over the old Sultai and were manipulative allies, now shunned.

entities.name: Naga
entities.description: Powerful magic users who claimed dragon ancestry and ruled the Sultai; many villages now have a naga protector.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: Honored Sultai undead raised through the Rite of Renewal.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A ritual after which the rebels fought and defeated the dragonlords.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that weakened Silumgar's forces.

entities.name: Abiding Harvest
entities.description: The core Sultai belief that all living things die and their essence nourishes the land for the next harvest.

events.summary: The Sultai fall from grace due to the actions of their human khan.
events.quote: The clan was originally ruled by humans , but due to the actions of their khan at the time, it fell from grace.

events.summary: Rakshasa and naga manipulate Tasigur into offending them, causing their defection.
events.quote: Tasigur was manipulated by the rakshasa and naga into a series of events that eventually led him to offend them, causing their defection.

events.summary: Tasigur makes a deal with Silumgar's brood, leading them to attack the Khan meeting.
events.quote: Tasigur was forced to make a deal with Silumgar 's brood, leading them to attack the Khan meeting that took place several years later.

events.summary: The Sultai are utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent clan.
events.quote: the Sultai were utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent Clan

events.summary: Tasigur is rewarded for betraying the khans by becoming Silumgar's slave and trophy of war.
events.quote: After betraying the other khans to the dragons, Tasigur was rewarded for this by becoming Silumgar's slave, his trophy of war.

events.summary: Sultai subjects foment resistance against Silumgar, supported by dissident naga necromancy.
events.quote: his subjects were some of the first in Tarkir to foment resistance against their dragonlord

events.summary: With Silumgar weakened and Teval's aid, the rebels defeat the dragonlord and take power.
events.quote: they fought and defeated the dragonlord, installing themselves in power

events.summary: The new Sultai reject the old cruelty and seek a new cultural identity through the counsel of ancient zombies.
events.quote: They found this in the counsel of the ancient zombies raised during the rebellion, who spoke of a time before the pacts with the rakshasa.

events.summary: The new Sultai outlaw raising unwilling individuals as sibsig.
events.quote: The new Sultai view this practice as symbolic of the cruel and wasteful decadence of the ruling classes and have outlawed the raising of unwilling individuals.
